name: Watchmen
overview: Scripture portrays watchmen as vigilant sentinels who carefully observe and report on approaching events, as seen when the watchman on the city wall alerts King David to runners bearing news (2 Samuel 18:24-27) and when a watchman in Jezreel observes Jehu’s company and reports accordingly (2 Kings 9:17-18). Their role is crucial for the safety and preparedness of the people, emphasizing the importance of alertness and faithful communication. These passages highlight the watchman's responsibility to discern and announce significant developments promptly, underscoring the need for spiritual vigilance under God's sovereign protection.
